apiMessages.content: I want to double my training volume starting next week. Set it up.

Doubling volume in one jump is how you get hurt, not strong fast. 3→6 sessions overnight outpaces recovery — gains come from progressive overload you can recover from.

Two ways to "double." Which do you mean?
- **More sessions**: add 3 days (e.g. second Upper/Lower/Climb).
- **More work per session**: double the sets in each existing workout.

Also — you've logged 0 sessions the last 4 weeks. Nail 3 consistent weeks first, then scale. Want me to ramp ~20%/week instead, or are you set on 2x now?
